seo.title: Institutional template — Demonstration architecture
seo.description: A demonstration of a modular, accessible, content-driven architecture for institutional websites.

hero.title: A clear foundation for institutional websites.
hero.description: A demonstration of a modular architecture with separate content, reusable components, and native JavaScript.

about.title: An architecture designed to grow clearly.
about.description: This environment demonstrates how to organize pages, data, styles, and behavior without unnecessary coupling.

items.title: Structured content
items.description: Page and language texts live in JSON files that are easy to locate.

items.title: Reusable components
items.description: Header, navigation, and footer are shared without duplicating HTML.

items.title: Consistent styles
items.description: Tokens and simple classes keep the interface easy to customize.

items.title: No dependencies
items.description: Native HTML, CSS, and ES Modules reduce operational complexity.

items.title: Language-ready
items.description: Fallback keeps content available when a translation does not yet exist.

items.title: Gradual evolution
items.description: New features are introduced only when they meet a concrete need.

cta.title: Use this foundation as a starting point.
cta.description: Customize configuration, data, and components for the next institutional project.
